# Retoucher Shoaib — Commercial Post-Production Studio

> High-end commercial photo retouching studio founded by Shoaib Siddique (10+ years experience). Specialized in luxury jewelry & watches, ghost mannequin & fashion lookbooks, natural skin model portraits, e-commerce packshots, automotive, and still life. Based on 100% manual Pen Tool clipping paths, 16-bit non-destructive frequency separation, and color-calibrated EIZO workflows.

## Commercial Departments & Services

- [Jewelry & Watch Photo Retouching](https://retouchershoaib.com/jewelry-watch-photo-retouching): Diamond facet brilliance, gemstone color fidelity, focus-stacking alignment at f/8–f/11, metallic luster polishing (platinum, yellow/white/rose gold), crystal anti-reflection, and dial alignment (10:10 protocol). Includes honesty guidelines for pre-owned horology.
- [Ghost Mannequin & Fashion Photo Retouching](https://retouchershoaib.com/ghost-mannequin-fashion-photo-retouching): 3D hollow neck joints, inner label insertion, hemline straightening, fabric wrinkle smoothing, weave texture retention, and pantone swatch color matching.
- [Model & Beauty Portrait Retouching](https://retouchershoaib.com/model-portrait-photo-retouching): Editorial and commercial skin retouching using manual dodge and burn with 16-bit frequency separation. Zero plastic blur; 100% real dermal pore structure preserved.
- [E-Commerce Product Photo Retouching](https://retouchershoaib.com/ecommerce-product-retouching): High-volume catalog editing, pure white backgrounds (RGB 255,255,255), transparent PNGs, hand-drawn vector clipping paths, and natural drop/contact shadows.
- [Automotive Photo Retouching](https://retouchershoaib.com/automotive-photo-retouching): Clean background replacement, paint glare and studio reflection smoothing, alloy wheel detailing, and grounded contact shadow rendering for dealerships and motorsport campaigns.
- [Still Life & Cosmetics Retouching](https://retouchershoaib.com/services#still): Glassware and bottle reflections, cosmetic dropper cleanup, texture gradients, and luxury packaging color grading.

## Technical Specifications & Workflow

- Color Management: Color-calibrated on EIZO ColorEdge 4K displays; support for ProPhoto RGB, Adobe RGB (1998), and sRGB color spaces.
- Selection Method: 100% hand-drawn Adobe Photoshop Pen Tool paths (vector clipping paths). Zero AI-generated jagged masks.
- Bit Depth: Full 16-bit workflow for smooth gradient tonality and shadow detail without banding.
- Raw Processing: Capture One Pro raw decoding and Adobe Photoshop master PSD/TIFF deliveries.

## Turnaround Times (SLAs) & Pricing Model

- Complimentary Trial: 1 free sample image edited with full 24-hour delivery for prospective commercial clients.
- Standard Turnaround: 24 to 48 hours depending on volume.
- Rush Service: 12-hour rush turnaround available for urgent editorial or campaign deadlines.
- Commercial Pricing Tiers:
  - Tier 01 (Clean & Standard): Essential clipping paths, color matching, clean white/transparent background, natural shadow.
  - Tier 02 (Advanced Commercial): Detailed dust & scratch cleanup, texture smoothing, collar & hemline alignment, reflection control.
  - Tier 03 (High-End Master): Complex focus stacking, non-destructive dodge & burn, custom metallic/skin micro-sculpting, billboard-ready exports.
  - Custom Enterprise Retainers: Dedicated retoucher capacity for high-volume monthly catalogs.

## Confidentiality, NDA & AI Training Protection

- Zero AI Training: Client raw files, lookbooks, and unreleased product prototypes are NEVER used to train generative AI models.
- Enterprise NDA: All files remain under strict non-disclosure agreement protection.
- Secure Storage: End-to-end encrypted storage via private Cloudflare R2 and Google Drive workspaces. Automatic 30-day archival cleanup available on request.
